title: DocumentExtract
description:
STAGE 3 of 5  |  produced by: extract (R2)  |  consumed by: compare (R3)

One per ATTACHMENT, so a normal comparison email yields two. detected_doc_type comes from the document's own header, not the filename - that is what makes wrong_doc_type detectable.

declared_role.description: From the filename. Lies on emails 501-505.

detected_doc_type.description: From the document header. 'SI' or 'BL' when recognised; the raw header text when it is something else (e.g. 'COMMERCIAL INVOICE'); null when unreadable.

parse_status.description: not_attempted means this format has no parser yet - it is NOT the same as unreadable.

fields.description: All seven keys are always present. present:false means not found in the document.

label_seen.description: The label text as it appeared, e.g. 'Load Port'. Kept for debugging the synonym table.

raw.description: Value exactly as written. Never normalised here - that is R3's step.
